tasks.title: Definition of done
tasks.description: Write the M2 done-list as a checklist a person can verify in the preview, and mirror it into BUILD.md. Scope is everything the design can actually do; the only exclusions allowed are technical ones, each with its number.
acceptance: every row has a check that can be seen or heard in the preview
no capability removed for preference; any exclusion cites a measured technical limit
the list may grow during production - growth is not a scope violation
evidence: BUILD.md Â§1 rewritten as the M2 done-list (2026-10-27): 24 preview-verifiable rows covering entry page, title/options/pause/game-over screens, HUD, visual identity, assets, authored data-driven level, effects, audio, feel, full run flow, arena progression, 8-beat ladder + overtime, Blackout, enemy roster (7 + Gunship boss), 12 weapon styles, 8 cards, airdrops, scoring, save/progression, performance budget, determinism.

BUILD.md Â§1 scope matches GAME.md (3-arena campaign, 8-beat ladder + overtime, 7 enemy types + Gunship boss, 3 weapon families/12 styles, 8 cards, full menus and audio; local leaderboards, progression, individual play built).

Technical exclusions section cites measured limits with numbers: co-op play (22 ms/frame at 720p > 16.67 ms budget; no signaling/relay server), shareable leaderboards (no backend; no cross-origin shared storage without server), mods (no sandboxed module loading/filesystem write; no mod endpoint; beyond 96 MB/150k tris/400-enemy cap). Each states the change required to allow it.

Design non-goals listed separately (classes, procedural maps, realistic ballistics, licensed names/models, paid/downloaded art, runtime network calls, mobile-specific layout, bundler/framework) as not-capabilities with no technical-limit citation.
Growth clause recorded: the list may grow during production; growth is not a scope violation; no capability removed for preference.

tasks.title: Produce the art as procedural sprite modules
tasks.description: Produce the game's art as PROCEDURAL SPRITE MODULES instead of binary image files. Create one module per asset under src/art/ (3 weapon silhouettes, 2 enemy silhouettes, ground texture, wall/bulkhead texture, card icon sheet, muzzle flash strip, impact spark strip).
